chronology.feature_source_rule: regular-season pitches with source_game_date strictly before target_game_date

classifier_inputs: all-prior regular-season PA outcome counts and rates
days since prior PA and outcome-class events
all-prior pitch-shape moments and pitch-type entropy

comparators: 2023-fit all-prior regular-season core without player identity or recency moments

selection_gates.materiality: candidate-minus-strongest-comparator point and date-block 95% upper bound must each be below negative 1% of comparator Brier and log loss
selection_gates.selection_calibration_diagnostic: report one-vs-rest calibration intercept and slope without post-selection fitting
selection_gates.selection_discrimination_diagnostic: candidate AUC must be noninferior at the point estimate
selection_gates.promotion_calibration_and_discrimination: fresh untouched confirmation must predeclare and pass date-block uncertainty for calibration and AUC; 2024 selection cannot satisfy this promotion gate
selection_gates.chronology: maximum contributing source date strictly precedes target date
selection_gates.fallback: no league-value feature imputation and no missing-source substitution

separate_components.hits: per-PA P(single or double or triple or home_run)
separate_components.hr_over_0_5: per-PA P(home_run); full-game market advancement requires separately proven pregame PA volume
separate_components.total_bases: per-PA distribution over 0,1,2,3,4 total bases; full-game market advancement requires separately proven pregame PA volume
